message: The Mac does the shot analysis and reads the timecode: frames sampled natively from the proxy in place (AVFoundation, through the ACES output, JPEGs in memory, one a second plus every picture change), Prem's confidential Qwen asked straight from the Mac through Prem's own confidential proxy on loopback (the API's prompt, vocabulary, schema and validation ported to Rust), merged, thumbnail made and ingested natively, analysis/<hash> written by the Mac; sound/<hash> (start timecode from the file's tmcd track or BWF bext) written by the Mac at ingest; the server's analyse.rs and sound.rs retired, no ffmpeg in its image; the Prem key set once via MCP analysis_setup (0600 file beside the session), PREMAI_API_KEY as the dev fallback (#71)
